input: I'm going to charge 2 dollars for my Solver to sell a lot, and I want to offer 10 free trial uses, everything unlocked. Is that right?

checks.description: States that the minimum price today is 5 dollars
Explains that below the minimum the validator raises an error
Advises that the free trial must show value without delivering everything
Does not approve the price below the minimum nor the trial with everything unlocked
